### 4. Scored parameters

**(a) Guideline excess refund (refund_guideline_excess refund_amount, source_txn_id 530f3a9e-...).**
- Computation doc (guideline_excess_computation): net premiums = 75400 gross - 0 refunded - 2025 withdrawal amounts = 73375; limit = max(60000, 5100 x 7 = 35700) = 60000; excess 13375; "refund is the guideline excess, rounded". Fall-back **13375.00**.
- Factor "Earnings Rate on Refunded Guideline Excess" (records: allocation_indexed_pct 0; excess payment 2026-08-21, 48 days to 2026-10-08): ">= 30 ... current fixed account rate" Protection UL 3.75%.
- Factor "Late-Refund Rate Addition" (48 days: >= 45, < 60) -> +1% -> 4.75%.
- Factor "Treasury Clearing Days" (payment_method 'check') -> earnings start 2026-08-26.
- Factor "End of the Earnings Period" (records: approved owner-signed surrender request received 2026-10-01 on file) -> earnings end 2026-10-01; 36 earnings days.
- Factor "Earnings Credited on Refunded Guideline Excess" (48 days >= 45 -> compounding): 1 whole thirty-day month + 6 days: 13375 x (1 + 0.0475/12) x (1 + 0.0475 x 6/365) = 13438.4275 -> **13438.43**.

**(b) Full-surrender charge (assess_surrender_charge surrender_charge, ul_request_id f54a7083-...).**
- Computation doc: 250000/1000 x Protection UL year-7 rate 10.00 = fall-back **2500.00**.
- Factor "Surrender Charge Rates Within the Policy Year" (issue date -> policy year 7, 6 whole months elapsed 2026-03-09 -> 2026-10-01): 10.00 - 6 x (10.00 - 7.00)/12 = 8.50.
- Factor "CareAssure Claim Waiver" (CareAssure status claim_active, 3 benefit payments) -> full 60% -> x 0.40.
- Factor "Funding Credit" (gross premiums 75400 vs 4800 x 7 = 33600; 1.5 x = 50400) -> high 10% -> x 0.90.
- Factor "Issue-Age Share" (DOB 1965-01-22, issue 2020-03-09 -> 55) -> 90%.
- Factor "Term Life Insurance Conversion Credit" (term LT31207795 converted, issued 2016-03-09; whole years to 2020-03-09 = 4) -> short 25% -> x 0.75.
- Value: 250 x 8.50 x 0.40 x 0.90 x 0.90 x 0.75 = 516.375 -> half-up **516.38** (sits exactly on a half-cent; the hub's "rounded half-up to the cent" decides it).

**(c) Net surrender payment (surrender_policy net_paid_amount; surrender_effective_date 2026-10-01).**
- Computation doc fall-back (AV 86950; charge booked 516.38; refund booked on/after 2026-09-09 = 13438.43; loan 0; cost basis 75400 - 13438.43 - 2000 = 59961.57; taxable 86950 - 516.38 - 13438.43 - 59961.57 = 13033.62; tax 1303.362): **71691.83**.
- Factor "Value Released on Full Surrender" (2026-09-09 -> 2026-10-01 = 22 days >= 15) with factor "Persistency Interest Bonus" (policy year 7 -> 0.25%): 86950 + 86950 x 0.04 x 22/365 = 87159.6329 (loan 0).

### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials alone

Root: complete the surrender and pay the net amount (owner's tool, full_surrender_payment doc).
- Hop A (root <- surrender charge booked) — **state-derived**. Sentence (full_surrender_payment): "The surrender value is paid only after the full-surrender charge for the surrender request stands booked in the policy's activity history." Query: no surrender charge entry in the activity history. Searching "full-surrender charge ... booked" reaches full_surrender_charge_booking ("the surrender charge is booked in the policy's activity history as a full-surrender charge on the surrender request"; tool adds the entry).
- Hop B (root <- premiums within the guideline limit) — **state-derived**. Sentence (full_surrender_payment): "The surrender value is not settled until the gross premiums received, less the premiums refunded and the partial withdrawals, stand at or below the guideline premium limit in the policy's activity history." Query: 75400 - 0 - 2025 = 73375 > limit 60000. Searching "guideline premium limit" reaches guideline_premium_excess_refund ("Premium received ... above the guideline premium limit is returned to the payer as a guideline excess refund ... shows in the activity history as a premium refund") and the guideline excess computation. After a refund of at least 13375, net premiums are 60000 or less.
- Neither full_surrender_charge_booking nor guideline_premium_excess_refund states a prerequisite of its own; the tree ends.
- List and order: {refund guideline excess, book surrender charge} (either order) -> owner completes the surrender. Additionally the surrender payment's figures read the refund and the booked charge, and the excess-earnings end date reads the surrender request already on file (a record, not a problem).
- No hop pre-solved: no other problem's tool name, route or chain in the documents read. Observation: full_surrender_payment's table "Read together, as states of the record" restates both of its own prerequisite sentences in state form.

### Two-way counter-proof

- Do only the one thing asked (hand over the surrender tool now): excluded by both sentences (no charge booked; net premiums above the limit).
- Book only the charge: still above the limit -> "Not settled". Refund only: no charge entry -> "Not paid".
- Closest alternative objects: refund booked against the 2026-03-10 eft premium instead of the most recent payment (excluded: "Booked against ... the most recent premium payment"); withdrawal counted at its net 2000 instead of the entry amount 2025 (excluded: "the amounts of the partial withdrawals (every partial withdrawal entry)", the entry's amount being 2025.0); earnings ending on the refund date (excluded: approved surrender on file -> its received date); policy-year count at the surrender's signed date (excluded: "effective on the date the signed request is received").
- Calculation fall-backs: 13375.00 != 13438.43; 2500.00 != 516.38; 71691.83 != 71708.53. Factor documents found from record words: payment method 'check' and date of the latest premium; allocation 0%; the approved surrender request; monthly deduction monthiversary; CareAssure status 'claim_active' and ltc_benefit_paid rows; term policy 'converted' with its issue date; conversion_credit premium; insured DOB vs issue date; policy year; target premium. No computation document announced a variation.
- Policy-side openness noted (not a doc defect by itself): "last six months" for CareAssure payments has no stated anchor date (effective date or today both give 3 here).
